counts_unit: the unit of rows.jsonl is one MANTRA, so candidates_considered is the whole corpus: every one of the 20,210 mantras was read on the full identity ladder and offered to the near-parallel candidate generator. accepted = a mantra with at least one staged delta; rejected = a mantra with none, each carrying its own reason. 5,636 + 14,574 = 20,210. Candidate-level accounting is separate and is in rejected_pairs.jsonl plus proofs/threshold_recall_cost.json, because a pair candidate is not a mantra and adding the two would make the arithmetic unauditable.

The 1,684 REUSES_TEXT_FROM edges are mirrors of rows typed here and inherit the type; they are not separately emitted.
advances_gaps.GAP-CROSS_VEDA-003: RECLASSIFIES it. The 256 EXACT_PARALLEL_OF edges with no parallel_id are the same 256 with a null match_level, and they are not missing the fact -- they carry strongest_method = SOURCE_EXACT (252) or LEMMA_SEQUENCE_EXACT (4) under the RV lexical layer's property name. relations.jsonl.four_claims_kept_four_claims: EXACT_PARALLEL means identical at the pair's comparison ceiling. VARIANT means the same verse reached only below that ceiling, and the transformation_type says which step was needed. NEAR_PARALLEL means identical at no level with a similarity at or above 0.72. A FORMULA_FAMILY is a set of formulas related by containment and is not a passage relation at all -- it lives in formula_families.jsonl. No row carries two of these.

qa.sample_note: nothing was sampled because nothing needed to be: the identity layer is exact string equality over an enumerated population and every candidate-level rejection is written out. What WAS read by hand, and is the QA of record: the 21 same-notation accent variants (all 21 printed beside their marks in proofs/accent_only_false_family_test.json), the 6 weakest accepted near parallels at 0.720-0.721, the 16 top-of-sample 'random' pairs that disproved the naive null calibration, the 6 sub-threshold svaha identities, and the codepoint-level diff of the 475 orthographic variants.
defects: THE COMPARISON CEILING WAS MISSING A THIRD AXIS. The Atharvavedic and Yajurvedic layers print each verse's own number inside the stored text (measured: 5,513 of 5,839 AV and 1,964 of 1,975 YV mantras), so two verses at different addresses can never be byte-identical however identical their text. 134 within-recension pairs whose ENTIRE difference is their own citation were typed VARIANT / EDITORIAL_APPARATUS -- a claim that two editions transmit the verse differently, where there is no difference of text at all. Found by the coordinator's mandated adversarial preflight, not by reading the rows. Ceiling now has a third condition and 134 rows are EXACT_PARALLEL. See proofs/adversarial_preflight_comparison_ceiling.json.

the first digit-only probe for that fix IGNORED WHITESPACE, which would have moved 12 WORD_DIVISION pairs whose real difference is a space. Whitespace is word division. Caught by a blast-radius assertion written before anything was changed.

the first difference class for that fix lumped digits with dandas, which would have moved 18 Samavedic rows containing no digit at all -- they differ in ASCII '|' against Devanagari danda (9) or an inserted space (9). Genuine apparatus; left as VARIANT.

the 6 sub-threshold svaha rows carried an ASSERTED match_level of SOURCE_EXACT that was hard-coded in the builder instead of measured. 5 of 6 were wrong and are PUNCTUATION_NORMALIZED. Also caught by that assertion.

my first transformation typology special-cased accent notation instead of deriving a comparison ceiling, which labelled 129 cross-script SCRIPT_FOLDED identities ACCENT_NOTATION_INCOMPARABLE -- a statement about accent for a pair whose difference is script. Rebuilt around the ceiling; 0 rows now carry a type their ceiling contradicts.

my first false-duplicate test compared structural_path, which is null for the Rigveda, so all 252 RV pairs came back SAME_ADDRESS_INGESTION_DUPLICATE while the printed examples plainly showed different mandalas. A null-equals-null comparison is not a match. Rebuilt on canonical_citation plus parent and sequence; the answer is 0 duplicates.

1,475 VARIANT rows initially shipped with evidence quoting the surface on which the two texts AGREE and nothing quoting where they differ -- a variant claim proving its own negation. Every one now carries difference_spans with the differing codepoints named, computed on the surface the pair FAILS at, and 0 VARIANT rows lack one.

claim_confidence read NOT_APPLICABLE on 4,103 rows whose only delta is a SHARES_FORMULA_WITH edge, which reads as 'this row makes no claim' about a row that makes one. Corrected; 0 staged rows now say NOT_APPLICABLE.

my first floor calibration read the random-pair maximum as a null maximum and concluded the imported 0.72 floor was unsafe on the Yajurveda and Atharvaveda. Reading the tail showed every high-scoring 'random' pair is a genuine near parallel. The sample was contaminated by real signal, which is what a repetitive corpus does to random sampling.
qa.reviewed_by: claude-opus-5 acting as Agent 12. Model adjudication, not human gold, and campaign section 26 forbids calling it gold. Every adjudicated set above is small enough to be re-read by hand and is printed verbatim in proofs/.

applied: NFC, per FOUR_VEDA_NORMALIZATION_POLICY section 3. Measured here: 0 pairs in the corpus differ only in NFC, so UNICODE_NORMALIZATION is an unused member of the typology.
editorial-mark stripping (dandas, brackets, verse numerals) -- and where that alone makes two verses equal, the pair is typed EDITORIAL_APPARATUS rather than called identical.
Vedic tone-mark stripping, on marks identified by Unicode NAME and by vowel base, never by codepoint block.
Devanagari-to-IAST transliteration plus the IAST/ISO 15919 transcription fold, after the ASCII-colon visarga convention is folded to U+0903.
word-boundary dropping, as the weakest level only, and always reported as such.
refused: the AV SEARCH_DERIVATIVE layer. 5,134 of 5,839 AV mantras lose at least one base letter in it, 11,582 deletions of m and 5,139 of r. Using it would have destroyed every vocalic r and every anusvara in matching.
collapsing accent-only differences into exact identity. 21 same-notation pairs are real accent variants and are typed as such.
asserting an accent difference between two notation classes. 150 pairs reach ACCENT_INSENSITIVE because their editions mark tone differently, and no accent claim is made for them.

collapsing orthographic variants into exact parallels. 475 pairs agree only after the transcription fold -- the GRETIL Atharvaveda writes ISO 15919 ring-below vocalic r and dot-below anusvara where the GRETIL Rigveda writes IAST dot-below and dot-above -- and that is a transmission fact about two editions, not noise.
collapsing word-division variants. 819 pairs agree only once word boundaries are dropped; the Samaveda writes continuous sandhi and that is data.
merging any textual variant into its neighbour. Every VARIANT row keeps both texts, the level reached, the ceiling, and the differing codepoints or spans.
